objective: Choose appropriate assistance for research, DITL drafting and pilot readiness.
clearance: Rewritten draft; pending SME and partner clearance

blocks.x: AI can make Blueprint preparation much faster. Its output is a draft that people review, never a decision.

blocks.x: Glean's internal tools include a Value Hypothesis Agent, which drafts strategic priorities, risks, and Positive Business Outcomes, and a Day-in-the-Life point-of-view generator, which drafts current and future timeline tables. Tool availability and permissions vary. An internal agent link doesn't mean a partner is entitled to use it. This course provides a prompt library with equivalent structured prompts, so you can do the same work in any approved environment.

blocks.label: Boundary
blocks.x: Each tool produces a reviewed draft, not a decision or an approval.
AI speeds up preparation and drafting. People still own the facts, the judgments, and the commitments.

blocks.title: What AI drafts, what people own
blocks.alt: A comparison of Blueprint tasks AI can help draft, such as account research summaries, interview notes, and first-draft workflow maps, with what people must own: verified facts, value judgments, and customer commitments.
